# JaffgenConfig

`jaff.cli.jaffgen.config.JaffgenConfig`

<!-- Generated by `python -m jaff._utils.api_docs`; do not edit. -->

Code-generation run (`[jaffgen]`, `jaffgen.toml` only).

## Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `template` | `str or None` | Built-in template collection. |
| `input_dir` | `Path or None` | Directory of template files to process. |
| `input_files` | `list of Path` | Individual template files. |
| `output_dir` | `Path or None` | Output directory; without it, `<repo_root>/generated`. |
| `network_file` | `Path or None` | Network file, or the name of a predefined network. |
| `network_config` | `Path or None` | `jaff.toml` to load instead of the one next to the network file. |
| `echo` | `bool` | Echo the template directives as comments in the output. |
| `table` | `list of dict` | `[[jaffgen.table]]` data-table conversions, passed on unchecked. |
